profiles.name: Lamine Yamal

physical.description: Identical kinematic limits for both candidates; no measured pace/reaction data is available.

confidence.description: One tournament and a small player sample. Context frequencies are smoothed toward other wingers; they are not calibrated real-world decision probabilities.

validation.interpretation: Held-out event-type frequency loss, lower is better. This does not validate movement or counterfactual outcomes.

assumptions: Pass/carry/shot event mix is used as a policy preference; event logging is not a sequence of all available decisions.
On-ball locations and carry direction preferences are transferred to off-ball positioning as a modeling assumption.
The anonymous Metrica scene is a separate tactical experiment, not an observed match by this named player.
Market value, age and future matches do not influence action selection.

methodology.contexts: Three longitudinal pitch zones × pressure/free, conditioned on recorded under_pressure flags.
methodology.probabilities: (player action count + 20 × winger-cohort action share) / (player context events + 20)
methodology.direction: StatsBomb actor-relative locations, scaled to 105×68 metres. No global tracking reconstruction.
methodology.model: Empirical behavior profile plus heuristic utility-based game agents; no neural-network training.
